extensionDescription.message: Capture the job posting you are looking at, keep it in your browser, and send it to your own Postulo for review when you say so. Nothing goes anywhere else.
extensionDescription.description: The extension's description, in the browser's list of extensions and in the store.

actionTitle.description: The toolbar button's tooltip, and the name of its keyboard shortcut.

postuloUnreachable.message: Postulo cannot be reached: what you send waits in this browser until it answers.
postuloUnreachable.description: The toolbar button's tooltip, first, while the icon is grey because Postulo does not answer; followed by the button's usual tooltip.

footerOnline.description: The title and spoken name of the popup footer's green tick before the address: Postulo answered within a second.

footerSlow.description: The title and spoken name of the popup footer's orange clock before the address: Postulo took more than a second to answer, or has not answered yet.

reviewHeading.description: Heading of the popup's list of postings captured and waiting for review, in Postulo or in this browser.

waitingInPostulo.description: A row of that list: the capture is in Postulo, waiting for review there.

nothingWaiting.description: Said in place of that list when it is empty.

lastListed.message: As Postulo last listed them, on $WHEN$.
lastListed.description: Under that list's heading when Postulo cannot be asked now (testing switch, no permission, unreachable, token refused). WHEN is a date and time already written in the person's language.

capturesOfPosting.description: A row of that list standing for several captures of one posting. COUNT is a number, two or more.

waitingForReview.description: The toolbar button's tooltip when postings are waiting for review in Postulo or in this browser. COUNT is a number.

settings.description: The gear that opens the extension's settings. Postulo's own word for its Settings.

capture.description: The popup's header button that captures the posting on the current page: its name and tooltip.

addListing.description: The popup's header button that opens Postulo's page for adding a job listing by hand. Postulo's own words for it.

captureHint.message: The page is read here, in your browser. Your Postulo, once set up, is asked only whether it already holds the page's postings, by their address, title and company; the page goes when you send it.

review.description: Link to the captured posting's review page in Postulo.

reading.description: Status while the page is read.

allowing.message: Allowing the extension to reach your Postulo…
allowing.description: Status while the browser asks for permission.

noPermission.message: Without permission to reach your Postulo, nothing can be sent.

sending.description: Status while the page is sent.

captured.message: Captured. Review it before it becomes a listing.
captured.description: After a capture: it waits for review in Postulo before joining the person's listings.

readBy.description: SOURCE is the capture source that understood the page, such as schema.org.

untitled.description: A captured posting whose page gave no title.

instanceLabel.description: Label of the field for the address of the person's Postulo.

instanceHint.message: The address you open it at. https, unless it runs on this machine.

tokenLabel.description: Label of the field for the token.

tokenHint.message: Made under $PATH$ in Postulo, with the $SCOPE$ scope and nothing more. It is kept on this device only, never synced through a browser account.
tokenHint.description: PATH is where tokens are made in Postulo (tokenPath), in italics; SCOPE is the scope's name, captures.

tokenPath.description: Where tokens are made in Postulo, in Postulo's own words for both.

test.description: Button that checks the address and the token.

shortcutHint.message: Pressing the button, or $SHORTCUT$, reads the page you are looking at, here in the browser. No page is read until you ask, and nothing goes anywhere but your own Postulo: it is asked whether it already holds the posting, by its address, title and company, and is sent the page when you say so.
shortcutHint.description: SHORTCUT is the key combination, Alt+Shift+P.

tokenMissing.message: Paste the token Postulo showed you.

saved.message: Saved. The button will now send pages to $HOST$.
saved.description: HOST is the host name of the person's Postulo.

savedNoPermission.message: Saved, but the browser refused permission to reach it; allow it in the extension's permissions.
savedNoPermission.description: Saved without the permission to reach the address.

asking.message: Asking Postulo who this token is…
asking.description: Status while the token is checked.

addressRefused.message: Permission to reach that address was refused.

tokenIs.description: NAME is the token's name; OWNER the account's email address.

tokenIsScoped.description: As tokenIs; SCOPES lists what the token may do, such as captures, read.

lacksCaptures.message: It lacks the captures scope, so it cannot capture.
lacksCaptures.description: captures is the scope's name in Postulo: keep it as it is.

noCredentialsInAddress.message: Leave the user name and password out of the address: it would never connect, and the password would be shown in the popup.
noCredentialsInAddress.description: The typed address holds a user name or password, as in https://user:secret@host.

tokenTooWide.message: This token can also: $SCOPES$. The extension needs the captures scope only: issue a token with that scope alone and revoke this one.
tokenTooWide.description: SCOPES is the list of the other scopes the token holds, in Postulo's own words: keep them as they are.

permissionRefused.message: Postulo's address was not allowed, so nothing was sent. The capture is kept and waits: allow the address and press Send again.
permissionRefused.description: The person refused the browser's permission prompt for their Postulo's address; the capture waits.

enterAddress.message: Enter the address of your Postulo.

notAnAddress.message: That does not look like a web address.
notAnAddress.description: What was typed is not an address.

httpsOnly.message: Use https for anything that is not on your own machine: the token travels with every request.
httpsOnly.description: An http address somewhere other than this machine.

tokenRefused.message: Postulo does not accept this token. Check it under $PATH$.

notAllowed.message: This token is not allowed to capture.

tooMany.message: Too many captures in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

answered.description: STATUS is an HTTP status code, such as 500.

notWebPage.message: Only web pages can be captured.
notWebPage.description: The tab shows something that is not a web page.

unreadable.message: The page could not be read. Some pages block extensions.

notPostulo.message: That address answered, but not as Postulo. Check the address, and any sign-in page in front of it.
notPostulo.description: The instance answered successfully with something that is not Postulo's JSON.

addressTooLong.message: This page's address is longer than Postulo accepts, even without the part after the “#”, so the capture was not sent. Add the posting in Postulo by hand instead.
addressTooLong.description: Shown on a capture that was not sent because its address is over the 500 characters Postulo takes (or was left out for being so). Postulo requires an address, so the capture cannot be sent without one.

reviewHint.message: This is what was read from the page. Correct anything that is wrong. Your Postulo is asked only whether it already holds this posting, by the address, title and company read; the page and your corrections go when you send it.
reviewHint.description: Above the form showing what was read, before the capture is sent. Postulo has been asked whether it holds the posting already (address, title and company only).

sendForReview.description: Button under that form: sends the page with the corrections, to be confirmed in Postulo.

notConnected.message: Not connected to a Postulo yet: what you capture is kept in this browser.
notConnected.description: Above the popup and the list while no address and token are set; followed by a Set it up button.

keep.description: Button beside Send for review: keeps the capture here without sending it.

kept.message: Kept in this browser. Send it to Postulo whenever you are ready.
kept.description: Status after Keep in this browser.

storageFull.message: This browser's storage for Postulo is full. Send or delete some captures, then try again.
storageFull.description: Shown when keeping or saving a capture is refused because the browser's storage quota is used up.

alreadyKept.message: You kept this page already and have not sent it: this is your version.
alreadyKept.description: Above the form when the page was captured before and not sent; the form shows the earlier edits.

nothingRead.message: Nothing could be read from this page. Fill in what you know. Your Postulo is asked only whether it already holds the page's address; what you fill in goes when you send it.
nothingRead.description: Above an empty form, when the page declared no posting and no title. Postulo is asked only whether it holds the page's address already.

waiting.message: Postulo cannot be reached right now. It is kept in this browser and sent as soon as Postulo answers.
waiting.description: After Send for review, when Postulo did not answer: the extension keeps trying in the background.

waitingOffline.message: The testing switch is on, so it waits in this browser. It goes once the switch is off.
waitingOffline.description: After Send for review while the testing switch in the settings is on.

waitingAccount.message: It is kept in this browser and sent once that is fixed.
waitingAccount.description: After a sentence saying Postulo refused the token: the capture waits until the token works.

sendNeedsSetup.message: Kept in this browser, to be sent once your Postulo is set up.
sendNeedsSetup.description: After Send for review with no address and token set.

capturesTitle.description: Title of the page listing every capture kept here, and the popup's link to it.

capturesIntro.message: Postings you captured, kept here until they reach your Postulo. What you send goes as soon as Postulo can be reached.

nothingKept.message: Nothing is kept in this browser.
nothingKept.description: That page, when there is no capture.

sendAll.description: Button on that page: sends every capture not sent yet.

clearSent.description: Button on that page: removes from the browser the captures Postulo has; they stay in Postulo.

stateKept.description: A capture's state: kept here, not sent.

stateWaiting.description: A capture's state: to be sent as soon as Postulo can be reached.

stateSent.description: A capture's state: Postulo has it, for review there.

stateRefused.description: A capture's state: Postulo would not take it; the reason is shown under it.

tryNow.description: Button on a capture waiting for Postulo: tries to send it at once.

holdBack.description: Button on a capture waiting for Postulo: it goes back to Not sent, and is not sent.

deleteConfirm.message: Delete this capture? It has not reached Postulo, so it exists only here.
deleteConfirm.description: Asked before deleting a capture that was not sent.

troubleshooting.description: Heading in the settings over the switch and the log.

offlineLabel.message: Act as if Postulo cannot be reached
offlineLabel.description: A checkbox in the settings, for testing: while it is on, nothing is sent.

offlineHint.message: For testing. While this is on, nothing is sent: captures wait in this browser exactly as they would with Postulo down, and go once it is off.

offlineOn.message: The testing switch is on: nothing is sent to Postulo.
offlineOn.description: A note at the top of the popup and the list, and a status in the settings, while the switch is on.

offlineOff.message: The testing switch is off: what is waiting goes to Postulo now.
offlineOff.description: Status in the settings when the switch is turned off.

downloadLog.description: Button in the settings: saves the log as a text file.

logHint.message: What the extension did, to find out why something did not work. It holds no token and nothing from the pages.

delete.description: Button deleting a capture from the browser. Postulo's own word.

edit.description: Button opening a capture's editor. Postulo's own word.

fieldTitle.description: Field label. Postulo's own word, from its posting form.

fieldCompany.description: Field label. Postulo's own word, from its posting form.

fieldLocation.description: Field label. Postulo's own word, from its posting form.

fieldRemote.description: Field label: on site, hybrid or remote. Postulo's own word.

fieldEmployment.description: Field label. Postulo's own word, from its posting form.

fieldSalaryFrom.description: Field label. Postulo's own word, from its posting form.

fieldSalaryTo.description: Field label. Postulo's own word, from its posting form.

fieldCurrency.description: Field label: a three-letter code such as EUR. Postulo's own word.

fieldPeriod.description: Field label: what the salary is per. Postulo's own word.

fieldCloses.description: Field label: when applications close. Postulo's own word.

fieldDescription.description: The posting's text, folded away. Postulo's own word.

remoteOnsite.description: A working arrangement. Postulo's own word.

remoteHybrid.description: A working arrangement. Postulo's own word.

remoteRemote.description: A working arrangement. Postulo's own word.

employmentFullTime.description: An employment type. Postulo's own word.

employmentPartTime.description: An employment type. Postulo's own word.

employmentContract.description: An employment type: fixed-term. Postulo's own word.

employmentFreelance.description: An employment type. Postulo's own word.

employmentInternship.description: An employment type. Postulo's own word.

employmentApprenticeship.description: An employment type. Postulo's own word.

periodYear.description: A salary period. Postulo's own word.

periodMonth.description: A salary period. Postulo's own word.

periodDay.description: A salary period. Postulo's own word.

periodHour.description: A salary period. Postulo's own word.

postingsFound.description: Above the list on a results page. COUNT is how many postings it lists.

tickHint.message: Tick the ones worth keeping. Each becomes its own capture, read again by Postulo.
tickHint.description: Under that line: what ticking does.

tickAll.description: Ticks every posting in the list.

tickNone.description: Unticks every posting in the list.

nothingTicked.description: Status when Send or Keep is pressed with nothing ticked.

keptMany.description: Summary after keeping several. COUNT is how many.

sentMany.description: Summary after sending several. COUNT is how many reached Postulo.

refusedSome.message: $COUNT$ were refused; the list of captures says why.
refusedSome.description: Status when Postulo refused some of a batch. COUNT is how many.

knownListing.message: Captured before: in your listings since $WHEN$ as $TITLE$.
knownListing.description: In the popup, when the address is already a listing. WHEN is a date, TITLE the listing's title.

knownCapture.message: Already waiting for review in Postulo, since $WHEN$.
knownCapture.description: In the popup, when a capture of the address is still waiting for review. WHEN is a date.

knownSimilar.message: A listing with this title at this company exists: $TITLE$.
knownSimilar.description: In the popup, when a listing with the same title at the same company exists. TITLE is its title.

knownTag.description: A small tag beside a listed posting Postulo already holds.

knownOpen.description: Link after the sentence above: opens the listing or the capture in Postulo.

pictureOffer.message: Postulo can keep a picture of the whole page as you see it, signed in or not. Send one?
pictureOffer.description: Asks, after a capture was sent, whether to also send a picture of the whole page. The server keeps it.

pictureSend.description: Button: draw the whole page and send it as a picture.

pictureSkip.description: Button: do not send a picture of the page.

pictureDrawing.description: Status while the whole page is drawn; a long page takes a few seconds.

pictureSending.description: Status while the picture of the page is sent.

pictureSent.description: Status after Postulo kept the picture of the page.

pictureNotKept.message: Postulo did not keep the picture. The capture itself is unaffected.
pictureNotKept.description: Status when Postulo refused the picture of the page for good (switched off, already decided, no room, too large, wrong type).

pictureTooBig.message: The page is too large to send as a picture.
pictureTooBig.description: Status when the picture cannot be made smaller than the limit Postulo set.

pictureFailed.message: The page could not be drawn. Is it still the one you captured?
pictureFailed.description: Status when the picture of the page could not be made, or the tab has moved to another page.

languageLabel.description: Label of the settings page's list of languages for the extension. Each entry in the list is the language's own name; the first is languageFollow.

languageFollow.description: First entry of the list of languages: the extension speaks the language the browser is set to, as it does until one is picked.

languageHint.message: Every language but English is a draft that no speaker has reviewed yet. Takes effect at once, without Save.
languageHint.description: Under the list of languages: the translations are unreviewed drafts, and picking one needs no Save.

reviewPageTitle.description: Title of the window where one captured posting is corrected and sent, kept or deleted.
